usage: eventboat run --config <pipeline.yaml> [--data-dir DIR] [--ephemeral] | eventboat run --config-dir <dir> [--runtime runtime.yaml]

flags:
  -config string
    	pipeline configuration file
  -config-dir string
    	directory of pipeline YAML files (multi-pipeline daemon with admin surface)
  -data-dir string
    	SQLite storage directory (deployment-level concern, POC flag) (default "data")
  -ephemeral
    	in-memory store: nothing persists across restarts
  -json
    	machine-readable output for agents and CI (the global --json, also accepted here)
  -runtime string
    	Runtime configuration file (telemetry endpoints; default: ./eventboat.yaml)
